importFiles.title: Import from CLIProxyAPI
importFiles.description: Move the subscription accounts that CLIProxyAPI or EasyCLIProxyAPI hold into LLM Hub once: upload their JSON auth files, paste their content, or load them straight from a running CLIProxyAPI. Codex, Claude, Antigravity, and xAI accounts become subscription accounts. LLM Hub checks every account with its provider first and renews its sign-in from then on. An account that is already connected gets the new sign-in.

auto.title: Automatic resets
auto.description: Spend a banked reset when usage of the tightest plan window reaches the threshold. LLM Hub checks every minute and tries at most once per account every 15 minutes.
auto.label: Automatic resets for {provider}
auto.thresholdHint: Between {min, number, percent} and {max, number, percent} usage.
auto.thresholdInvalid: Enter a whole number between {min, number, percent} and {max, number, percent}.
auto.scopeOption: {scope, select, pool {When every account is at the threshold} account {When one account is at the threshold} other {{scope}}}
auto.scopeHint: {scope, select, pool {Spends one reset only when no account of this provider has room left.} account {Each account spends its own reset as soon as it reaches the threshold.} other {}}
auto.claudeNote: Claude only accepts a reset once the account is at its limit, so a lower threshold waits until then. The Fable limit counts too. LLM Hub uses the smallest reset that refills the full limits. When only Fable is full, that is a Fable reset.

kickoff.title: Start the next window at reset
kickoff.description: A usage window begins with the first request. When a window of an account has reset, LLM Hub sends “Only reply with ok.” to the chosen model on that account, so the next window starts right away and resets sooner. LLM Hub checks every minute, sends at most once per reset or once an hour while a window has not started, and skips paused, signed-out, and still limited accounts.
kickoff.label: Window start for {provider}
kickoff.modelHint: Models that route to {provider} accounts. A small model uses the least of the new window.
kickoff.noModels: No model routes to {provider} accounts yet. Add one on the Models page first.

subAdd.title: Add-account links
subAdd.description: Share a link with friends or colleagues so they can connect their own subscription account to this hub. They need no console login and, if the link allows it, can disconnect their account at any time.
subAdd.createdHint: LLM Hub keeps only a fingerprint of the link, so it cannot be shown again. It stops working when it expires, every account slot is used, or you delete it, and finished links are deleted automatically.
